reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a detailed materials list instead of hiding costs behind vague chips. Each entry shows you exactly what materials are stored and required, with any shortages clearly highlighted. This change makes planning your buildings much easier! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We've made a major update to Provincia! Build tiles now show a materials list that details what you have and what you need for your constructions. This improvement eliminates the confusion of previous cost badges and allows for a more strategic building process. For more information, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
